200.description: Directory listing for the resolved path, or an error message if it couldn't be listed.

path.title: Path
path.description: Resolved absolute path that was browsed.

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: Absolute path of the parent directory, or null if `path` is the filesystem root.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the file or directory entry (hidden entries starting with '.' are excluded).

is_dir.title: Is Dir
is_dir.description: Whether this entry is a directory.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Non-hidden files and directories found in `path`, directories first then alphabetically by name.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if the directory couldn't be listed (e.g. permission denied), otherwise null.
